title: Config-linked promptset gating, snapshot lineage, and curator ACLs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an engineering workflow and APIs to bind promptset/golden dataset snapshots to specific model-config rollouts and runtime config changes, enable curator ACLs and immutable snapshots, and wire automatic eval runs that can block or flag rollouts in CI/rollout pipelines.
motivation: We need deterministic signal when model or config changes cause regressions against production-quality prompts. Currently evals are ad-hoc and not consistently pinned to rollout artifacts, which leads to late detection of regressions and customer incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Curators can create immutable golden snapshots with a unique snapshot-id that includes provenance metadata (author, date, base-promptset-version, tagging).
Snapshots can be ACL-protected; only curator or a steward role can publish or revoke snapshots.
A model-config object can reference one or more snapshot-ids; the deployment orchestration uses linked snapshots to trigger a gated eval run before traffic shift.
CI gate integration: evaluation results are posted as structured verdicts (pass/warn/fail) with a numeric quality delta; failure prevents canary promotion until triaged.
Dashboard shows snapshot lineage and eval history per model-config; can filter by dataset labels and config changes.
API and SDK endpoints are documented and have basic end-to-end tests in the evals integration suite.
implementation_notes: Add immutable snapshot store in evals catalog backed by S3 + signed metadata manifest; manifests include SHA256 of prompt bundle and list of sample eval runs used for baseline.
Extend access-control service with new 'curator' and 'snapshot-publisher' roles and map to SSO groups; enforce via console and API endpoints.
Create a small microservice 'snapshot-gateway' to accept snapshot creation requests, validate manifests, run lightweight integrity checks, and emit events to the gating pipeline.

Integrate with pipeline: upon model-config change, orchestration posts a 'pre-rollout-eval' job referencing snapshot-id(s); job runner executes evals, computes metrics and delta relative to snapshot baseline, and writes verdict to the rollout API.
Design a compact verdict schema: {verdict: pass|warn|fail, delta_score: float, metric_breakdown: list}, ensure it is JSON-serializable and stored in evals DB.
Performance: ensure gating evals use sampling and parallelization to complete within 4 minutes for typical canary sizes; fallback to async non-blocking reporting for heavy suites.
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff meeting with PM, design, and infra; agreed scope and success metrics (false-positive tolerance, gating latency SLA=4m).
2026-02-27: Prototype manifest schema and snapshot CLI created (ENG branch: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/eng-15802-snapshot-cli).
2026-03-03: Security reviewed proposed role mappings; KMS integration flagged as dependency (ENG-14847).
2026-03-05: API contract review with SDK team; added structured verdict fields as requested by Console (console-2026.03 board).
2026-03-08: First integration test failing intermittently due to nondeterministic prompt ordering; implementing canonical sort in the snapshot creator.
2026-03-10: Snapshot gateway MVP deployed to staging; manual end-to-end gating run executed against a synthetic model-config and blocked on a regression (expected).
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Large eval suites could exceed gating latency SLA. Mitigation: implement prioritized sampling and progressive scoring with early stopping heuristics.

Risk: Curator mistakes could freeze rollouts if snapshots are incorrectly published. Mitigation: provide a 'dry-run' publish and require two-curator approval for snapshots affecting production rollouts.
Risk: ACL complexity leads to permission gaps. Mitigation: create audit tooling for snapshot publish/revoke events and add an emergency bypass workflow for SRE with audit log retention.
qa_plan: Unit tests for snapshot manifest validation and canonicalization.
Integration tests: create snapshot -> link to model-config -> trigger gating eval -> assert verdict flows to rollout API.
Load test: measure gating pipeline latency with 100 concurrent canary jobs using sampled eval sets.
Security test: verify role enforcement and KMS key usage for snapshot metadata signing.
next_steps: Finish canonical ordering fix and add test case for nondeterministic prompt bundles.
Wire snapshot publish flow to SSO group for curators and add ACL UI in Console (design handoff scheduled 2026-03-12).
Implement verdict persistence and expose API for rollout service to consume before week end.
